title: 第一千六百七十二章 妖人第一千六百七十一章 被嫌弃了
slug: 大道神主第一千六百七十二章妖人
content_zh:
“你怎么看？”萧叶没有做主，而是询问了小青，毕竟整个药园子都是小青在打理，他还是把抉择权给了她。
“药园子的规模也足够大，再要一两个助手也不是不行。但，它们都已经成为了绝对的妖兽了，失去了原本独属于草木之力那种对于植物的亲和力，帮不上太大的忙。”
“我确实可以帮忙提纯它们的血脉，但也不能白干。”
“所以，我让它们去收集了这里的资源，就是这个东西，你应该感兴趣吧。”
小青手中拿着一个如同兽核，但是比起兽核要有着更加纯粹的妖力，这就是灵魂在这里陨落以后，兽核和妖丹的结合之物。
对于妖族是绝顶的修炼至宝，可对于萧叶而言，炼药什么的都用不上了。
“也对，这东西不能炼药了，就给苏姐姐你吧。侯姐姐应该也喜欢这东西，我让它们多收集一些。”小青下令，萧叶已经把抉择权交给了她，她也就不再问些什么了。
这些妖兽也答应了，能够提纯血脉也不错，至少不再那么轻易的被压制了。收集这些东西，这本身就是它们来到这里的另外一个目的，只不过一部分用来交易了而已。
说着，那些妖兽就从身体中拿出来一些，交给了小青。
萧叶看到以后，摸了摸自己的身体，道：“原来在这里，灵魂还可以这么用，学到了。”
“主人，你也得不到传承，而且这里似乎也不需要你的保护，为什么不离开这里，这里应该困不住你才对啊？”小青问道，萧叶把情况稍微的解释一遍。
“怎么会有这么麻烦的主人，走到那里都是麻烦。”小青一脸的嫌弃样子，随后将一团能量打入萧叶的身体内：“这是我木灵珠独有的灵力，可以短暂的屏蔽你的气息。”
“该忙你的事情就去忙你的吧，我在这里是安全的，我若是躲起来那些妖兽是找不到我的。苏姐姐你也去吧，技多不压身，多一个强大的神通秘法在身，还是有好处的。”
“好好好，我听我家小青的。”苏灵韵摸了摸小青的头，看着萧叶说道：“你看看小青多好的一个姑娘，以后有活自己干，别总是什么事情都麻烦她，她还这么小。”
萧叶眼皮跳动，自己的地位又低了？
年龄小...这丫头算作当青木灵的年龄，比他所有的家眷加在一起都要大得多。
“好好好，关键那些事情我也不会啊。”萧叶说道，小青则是一副我有靠山的样子。
萧叶有着小青的气息遮掩，倒是可以安静一些时间了。
也正如她说的这般，他在这里确实有些浪费时间，毕竟得不到传承，还会受到袭击。
只有灵魂体，很多东西……

忽然，萧叶想到了什么，在这里他一直都是想着找到小青等帮忙为其护法，根本没有朝其他方面去想，现在想明白了，说不定还是有收获的。
“韵儿，我就不陪你了，我突然想到了什么说不定还是有得忙的。”萧叶说道，直接调动自身的法则力量，寻找自己的肉体所在。
都是谁在一张床上的人了，苏灵韵也差不多看出来萧叶的想法了。
在这里，虽然修为大部分都融入到的灵魂当中，可妖兽本身最依赖的还是自身的血脉。
保不齐那些妖兽有着某种手段，从而让灵魂回到存放肉体的地方，将没有灵魂的躯壳给吞掉。
这很难，妖庭也是极为善于炼制阵法的，想要破解凭借现如今的妖族…难。
难不代表没有可能，如今，也唯有萧叶能够通过空间之力，无视这里的规则限制回到肉体了。
至于蓝羽……没办法，不怕一万，就怕万一，无论是小青还是苏灵韵，若是被发现了肉体，可是极为危险的。
最起码，他尽可能的保护肉体，时不时的灌输灵力，如此灵魂应该就不会枯竭了。
很快，萧叶就感知到了自己肉体，下一瞬灵魂消失。再一次睁开双眼，就看到了一头巨大的蟒蛇在自己面前游荡。
放眼看过去，这里全部都是妖兽，各个种族的都有，甚至都看到了已经灭绝的。
这里的大部分妖兽都只剩下的尸体，有的都已经成为白骨了，可见这里无法冻结时间。
萧叶直接行动起来，寻找着苏灵韵等人的肉体所在。
萧叶自己也说不清楚是幸运还是倒霉，当他找到苏灵韵的肉体的时候，还真就有着一个妖人在那里，想要夺取苏灵韵的血脉。
这他能忍，直接冲上去就是干架，那妖人也是吓一跳，不知道萧叶怎么出现的。
“人族！人族怎么会出现在这里？”妖人有些疑惑，一个纯粹的人族是怎么来到这里的。
“坤甲族。”萧叶认出来这个妖人的族群，就是一个特殊的昆虫族群，但乾为天，坤为地，阴阳演变，四象八卦。
这一族在阵法上则是有着特别的天赋在，那就是无论学没学过阵法一道，面对阵法的时候都能找到阵法的生门破绽所在，属于得天独厚了。
萧叶试着沟通了一下苏灵韵的灵魂，发现他可以直接把灵魂给摄取回来且不会影响，再将其收入九黎壶，感知了一下灵魂的情况，也没有出现什么变化，这才让他放心。
这让对于蓝羽的愧疚，也少了很...不对，自己愧疚什么，那是自己的坐骑，而且几乎没有怎么尽到坐骑该有责任，愧疚个屁，应该是对方惭愧才对。

看着眼前的妖人，萧叶并没有第一时间与之纠缠，而是离开寻找小青和小灵儿等人，保护她们肉体的安全才是最重要的。
至于这个坤甲族的妖人，待会在收拾也来得急。
咻！
萧叶直接消失在原地，出现在小青的肉体身旁，依旧是如此，同样是有着一个坤甲族的妖人想要对小青的肉体出手，依旧是同样的待遇。
content_en:
"What do you think?" Xiao Ye did not make the decision, but asked Xiao Qing. After all, Xiao Qing was in charge of the entire medicine garden, so he still gave her the right to make the decision.
"The scale of the medicine garden is large enough, and it is not impossible to have one or two assistants. However, they have become absolute monsters. They have lost the affinity for plants that was originally unique to the power of vegetation, so they cannot help much."
"I can indeed help purify their blood, but it can't be in vain."
"So, I asked them to collect the resources here. This is what you should be interested in."
Xiao Qing is holding a beast core in his hand, but it has more pure demon power than the beast core. This is the combination of the beast core and the demon elixir after the soul falls here.
For the demon clan, it is the ultimate cultivation treasure, but for Xiao Ye, it is useless for refining medicine or anything else.
"That's right, this thing can't be used to make medicine, so I'll give it to you, Sister Su. Sister Hou should also like this thing, so I'll ask them to collect more." Xiao Qing ordered. Xiao Ye had already given the decision to her, so she stopped asking any more questions.
These monsters also agreed. It would be good to be able to purify their blood, at least they would no longer be suppressed so easily. Collecting these things is another purpose of coming here, but some of them are used for trading.
With that said, those monsters took some out of their bodies and gave them to Xiao Qing.
After Xiao Ye saw it, he touched his body and said, "So here, the soul can still be used in this way, I learned it."
"Master, you can't get the inheritance, and it seems that you don't need your protection here. Why don't you leave here? You shouldn't be trapped here?" Xiao Qing asked, and Xiao Ye explained the situation in detail.
"How can there be such a troublesome master? It's troublesome wherever he goes." Xiao Qing looked disgusted, and then injected a ball of energy into Xiao Ye's body: "This is the unique spiritual power of my Wood Spirit Pearl, which can temporarily block your breath."
"Go and do your business when it's time to do it. I'm safe here. If I hide, those monsters won't be able to find me. Sister Su, you can go too. Having more skills doesn't overwhelm you. It's still good to have a powerful magical power and secret method in your body."
"Okay, okay, I listen to my Xiaoqing." Su Lingyun touched Xiaoqing's head, looked at Xiao Ye and said, "Look at what a good girl Xiaoqing is. In the future, you can do your own work. Don't always bother her with everything. She is still so young."
Xiao Ye's eyelids twitched, his status was low again?
Young... This girl's age as a Green Wood Spirit is much older than all his family members put together.
"Okay, okay, I don't know those key things either." Xiao Ye said, while Xiao Qing looked like I had someone to back me up.
Xiao Ye was covered by Xiao Qing's aura, so he could be quiet for some time.
Just as she said, he was indeed wasting his time here. After all, he would not get the inheritance and would be attacked.
Only the soul body, many things...
Suddenly, Xiao Ye thought of something. Here, he had always thought about finding Xiao Qing and others to help him protect the law. He didn't think about other aspects at all. Now that he thought about it, he might still gain something.
"Yun'er, I won't accompany you anymore. I suddenly thought of something and I might still be busy." Xiao Ye said, directly mobilizing the power of his own laws to find his body.
They were all on the same bed, and Su Lingyun could almost tell what Xiao Ye was thinking.
Here, although most of the cultivation is integrated into the soul, the monster itself relies most on its own blood.
It seems that those monster beasts have some means to let the soul return to the place where the body is stored, and swallow the soulless body.
This is difficult. Demon Court is also very good at refining formations. If you want to breakIt is difficult to solve the problem with today's demon clan.
Doesn't it mean it's impossible? Now, only Xiao Ye can use the power of space to return to the body regardless of the rules and restrictions here.
As for Lan Yu... I have no choice but to be afraid of ten thousand, just in case. Whether it is Xiao Qing or Su Lingyun, if their bodies are discovered, it will be extremely dangerous.
At the very least, he protects the body as much as possible and instills spiritual power from time to time, so that the soul should not be exhausted.
Soon, Xiao Ye felt his body, and his soul disappeared in the next moment. When he opened his eyes again, he saw a huge python wandering in front of him.
Looking at the past, there are all monsters here, from all races, and even extinct ones can be seen.
Most of the monsters here have only corpses left, and some have become bones. This shows that time cannot be frozen here.
Xiao Ye took action directly and searched for the bodies of Su Lingyun and others.
Xiao Ye himself couldn't tell whether it was luck or unlucky. When he found Su Lingyun's body, there was really a demon there who wanted to take Su Lingyun's bloodline.
He could bear this and rushed forward to start a fight. The demon was also startled and didn't know why Xiao Ye appeared.
"Human race! Why did the human race appear here?" The demon was a little confused, how did a pure human race come here.
"Kun Jia Clan." Xiao Ye recognized this demon clan as a special insect clan, but Qian is the sky, Kun is the earth, Yin and Yang evolve, and the four images are Bagua.
This clan has a special talent in formations, that is, regardless of whether they have learned formations or not, they are able to find the flaws in formations when faced with formations, which is a unique blessing.
Xiao Ye tried to communicate with Su Lingyun's soul and found that he could directly absorb the soul back without any impact. He then put it into the Jiuli Pot and sensed the condition of the soul. There was no change, which reassured him.
This makes Lan Yu feel less guilty... No, what do I feel guilty about? It is my mount, and it has hardly fulfilled the responsibilities of the mount. I am so guilty. It should be the other party who is ashamed.
Looking at the demon in front of him, Xiao Ye did not get entangled with him immediately, but left to look for Xiao Qing, Xiao Ling'er and others. Protecting their physical safety was the most important thing.
As for the demon from the Kunjia Clan, it will be urgent to deal with it later.
call out!
Xiao Ye disappeared directly and appeared next to Xiao Qing's body. It was still the same. There was also a demon from the Kunjia tribe who wanted to take action on Xiao Qing's body, and he still received the same treatment.
